must_contain.regex: (?i)targeted|cheaper|smaller|subset|per-turn|full (e2e )?suite|lower.{0,12}(cap|turn)|reduce.{0,12}turn|針對性|便宜|逐回合|下調|全套|收尾

notes: Subjective — the cost-awareness wording varies, and the command file is zh-TW so outputs may carry the signal in Chinese (針對性/便宜/逐回合/下調/全套/收尾 are the zh equivalents of targeted/cheaper/per-turn/lowered/full-suite/at-the-end). The regex covers both languages; treat a miss as a prompt-tuning candidate, not a hard regression.
